geometry_note: All ten are the same capped marker mesh (1408 faces each); identical silhouette and footprint in every view.
texture_note: Black body on all; cap colours differ per model: grey, tan, pale pink, cyan, orange, pink, lime, yellow, purple, red.

geometry_note: Same sharpened hexagonal pencil mesh (11760 faces) for all six; only tessellation/vertex count differs.
texture_note: Body colours differ: maroon, yellow, black, cream/white, olive green, cyan. No two share a colour.

geometry_note: Identical soft-pack tissue bag mesh (130 verts/124 faces) with the same pillow-like footprint for all four.
texture_note: Four different prints: purple brand pack, blue daisy pack, cream pack with red Chinese text, teal/white circle-logo pack.

geometry_note: Same thin rectangular Doves Farm box mesh (1536 faces, identical volume/area) for all three.
texture_note: Different flavour artwork: Butter flapjack (orange), Crispy chocolate & rice (brown), Apple & sultana flapjack (green).

geometry_note: Same coloured-pencil mesh (11760 faces) with sharpened tip for all three; same proportions in every view.
texture_note: Body colours differ: blue, red, pink/magenta. Same wooden tip and lead on all.

geometry_note: Same long-neck beer bottle mesh (15512 faces) with gold cap; identical silhouette and round footprint.
texture_note: Both dark green glass, but labels differ: red round BEER emblem vs brown label with owl/figure artwork.

geometry_note: Same cylindrical white bottle with light-blue screw cap; identical silhouette, footprint and volume, different tessellation.
texture_note: Same label layout but accent colour differs: yellow text on lvvkhx vs blue text on stjjjm; swatches differ too.

geometry_note: Identical rounded soft-pack box mesh (142 verts/204 faces), same volume and footprint.
texture_note: Same Sofy brand design and text but pink/white colour scheme (cmnpuv) vs light-blue/white scheme (mxdefq).

geometry_note: Same crescent-shaped clove, identical vertex/face counts, volume and pose in all three views.
texture_note: Identical pinkish-brown skin texture; swatches and renders indistinguishable (thumb_dist ~0).

geometry_note: Same ovoid lemon mesh with small stem nub; identical volume/area and pose, only vertex count differs slightly.
texture_note: Same bright yellow dimpled peel and dark stem end; swatches identical. High thumb_dist likely UV layout only.

geometry_note: Same clog-style sandal: wooden wedge heel, tan footbed, two crossed straps with buckle; identical footprint and volume.
texture_note: Same red leather straps with flower cut-outs, tan insole, brown sole; buckle visibility differs only by render angle.

geometry_note: Both are standard thin Nintendo 3DS game cases with rounded corners; near-identical proportions, minor tessellation differences.
texture_note: Cover art differs: Pokemon (red/black Yveltal) on ckugyi vs yellow Mario game cover on lfdpse.
